description: Recipes++ expands your production options with new fuels and buildings. Synthetic Diesel burns cleaner and faster, with its own refuel station, generator and vehicle variants. Liquefied Coal, Supercharged Biomass, Greenhouse GMO and Pesticide upgrades, a Bio Processor, and a Liquifier for converting solids to liquid or gas round out the new chains, and more.
description_short: New fuels, synthetic vehicles, and production chains — Synthetic Diesel, Liquefied Coal, Supercharged Biomass, Bio Processor, Liquifier, and more
